Record Class CourseTargetsService.CourseTargets

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
edu.ucsb.cs.taapply.services.CourseTargetsService.CourseTargets
Record Components:
allocation - the TA or ULA positions the admin allocated to the course (0 when unset)
candidateCount - the real, non-cancelled applicants who expressed interest in the course (first or second choice, Enthusiastic or Would Consider)
rankingTarget - how many candidates the instructor is asked to rank: twice the allocation, but never more than there are interested candidates; 0 when nothing was allocated
rankedCount - how many real, non-cancelled applicants the instructor has ranked for the course, interested or not (the same count as the admin's Rankings column)
stillNeeded - rankingTarget minus rankedCount, never below 0
Enclosing class:
CourseTargetsService
public static record CourseTargetsService.CourseTargets(Long recruitmentCourseId, int allocation, int candidateCount, int rankingTarget, int rankedCount, int stillNeeded) extends Record
